QuestInfo.name: Carcion Public Works 1
QuestInfo.0: #bLupamo#k, the Snake Anima elder, has something to say to you. Listen to Lupamo in #b#m410007607##k.
QuestInfo.1: Lupamo has asked you to help with one of Carcion's public works projects -- which has something to do with sensing Keira's power. Ask Lupamo for the details.
QuestInfo.2: According to Lupamo, reactivating Carcion's barrier will require a power similar to Keira's.
